matches.title: Associate QA Engineer
matches.text: Experience: 2 to 3 Years Location: Chennai Employment Type: Contract About the Company iTech India, a premier digital transformation services organization established in 2003, has achieved significant milestones over 21 years by serving a diverse range of domestic and international clients. With a team of nearly 400 employees operating from multiple locations, our mission is to drive clients successfully by delivering innovative solutions and exceptional service. We specialize in providing end-to-end digital transformation services, enabling businesses to leverage cutting-edge technologies and optimize their operations. Our expertise spans various domains, including software development, IT consulting, data analytics, and more. Join us at iTech India, where we are committed to making a difference through technology and innovation. About the Role We are looking for a passionate Associate QA Engineer with 2–3 years of hands-on experience in Manual and Automation Testing to join our QA team. The role focuses on executing structured testing across web and mobile applications, contributing to automation script development in Java + Selenium, and ensuring high-quality releases through disciplined test practices. The ideal candidate is curious, detail-oriented, and eager to grow — someone who takes ownership of assigned modules, collaborates closely with developers and business analysts, and consistently delivers reliable test outcomes. Key Responsibilities Test Execution Perform manual testing across functional, regression, integration, and system levels for web and mobile applications. Execute assigned test cases, log defects with clear reproduction steps, and verify fixes. Participate in sprint testing cycles and support releasereadiness activities. Automation Testing Develop, execute, and maintain automation scripts using Java + Selenium under the guidance of senior engineers or the QA lead. Contribute to the automation framework by adding reusablecomponents and improving script stability. Analyze automation results, triage failures, and raise defects for genuine issues. Mobile Testing Perform functional and compatibility testing on Android and iOS devices. Validate application behavior across different versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. Test Design & Documentation Write and maintaintest cases, test data, and test execution reports for assigned modules. Keep documentation up to date in test management tools (e.g., JIRA, TestRail). Collaboration Work closely with developers, businessanalysts, and project managers to clarifyrequirements and confirm expected behavior. Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies — stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Communicate testing status, blockers, and risks proactively to the QA lead. Key Requirements and Skills 2–3 years of hands-on experience in software testing across web and mobile applications. Solid understanding of Manual Testing — functional, regression, integration, and system testing. Working experience with Automation Testing using Java + Selenium. Exposure to Mobile Application Testing on Android and/or iOS. Familiarity with test management and bug tracking tools such as JIRA and TestRail. Good understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail. Good written and verbal communication skills. A learning mindset— willingness to pick up new tools, frameworks, and domains. Good to Have Exposure to API testing using Postman or similar tools. Basic knowledge of SQL for backend data validation. Familiarity with CI/CD tools like Jenkins or GitHub Actions. ISTQB Foundation Level certification. To Apply We would like to hear from you! To apply for the position of Associate QA Engineer, visit www.itechindia.co/careers with an updated resume or CV highlighting your relevant experience and qualifications. Alternatively, you may get in touch with our recruitment team at recruitment@itechindia.co .

closest.text: Hire AI Automation Developer: Key Skills & Evaluation Solutions ▾ AI Agents ▾ Work Blog Company ▾ Become a Client ☰ Solutions + AI Agents + Work Blog Company + Become a Client Sales · +1 (408) 444-8001 Sales IN · +91 87805 88560 HR · +91 079-48948998 [email protected] Back to blog Ai Workflow Automation Hire AI Automation Developer - What to Look For and How to Evaluate Find out how to hire an AI automation developer by focusing on key skills, interview insights, and project preparation to ensure your AI workflow automation is a success. Avkash Kakdiya Writer at iTechNotion 15 Jun 2026 20 min read Share X in f 20 min 1. The skills gap — why finding a real AI automation developer is harder than it sounds Getting a hold of a genuine AI automation developer isn't as easy as it might seem. There's a sea of professionals and agencies touting automation services, but truth is, few truly have the chops for advanced AI-powered workflow automation . Many stick to popular no-code tools like Zapier for app connections, but real AI automation? It needs complex setups, custom logic, and ever-evolving AI models. Take iTechNotion , for instance. They helped a fintech company refine loan application processing using AI-driven document analysis mixed with workflow automation. This gig called for developers not just good at API orchestration but who can also handle natural language processing and decision-making logic. Finding developers who mesh these skills is tough because genuine AI automation pulls from multiple disciplines. Industry insiders like Gartner point out that pairing AI with automation (a.k.a. hyperautomation) requires talents versed in AI frameworks and workflow engines. Many traditional developers just don't have the hands-on AI experience, leading to meh results. So, getting clear on what an AI automation developer really does will help you zero in on candidates with real know-how. 2. What an AI automation developer actually does — beyond Zapier setup AI automation developers craft smart workflows to slash manual work, boost accuracy, and scale operations. Their gig goes way beyond hooking up apps with simple triggers and actions. Workflow design with AI capabilities They cook up workflows using AI services like natural language understanding, image recognition, or predictive analytics. Imagine automating customer support by sending queries along and cooking up AI-powered responses with decision trees tied to AI APIs. Custom API integrations and orchestrations Unlike easy no-code automation, AI developers whip up custom code or use sophisticated workflow tools for complex API calls, error management, and asynchronous processing. This keeps data flowing smoothly between AI models and business systems. Building adaptive automation systems AI automation isn't static; developers create systems that roll with new data or outcomes, like flagging issues when AI spots weird patterns or updating models with fresh data. This kind of complexity demands a mix of AI and software engineering savvy. All in all, AI automation developers blend software engineering, AI know-how, and integration expertise to whip up scalable, lasting automation solutions. 3. The technical skills to look for — n8n, LangChain, API integrations, workflow design When hiring an AI automation developer, zero in on their proven technical skills that match your needs. Expertise in workflow automation platforms like n8n n8n 's an open-source gem that lets developers fashion one-of-a-kind workflows with conditional logic, API calls, and integrations across systems. Vet their experience with real projects or samples of their code. Knowledge of LangChain and AI model orchestration LangChain's a framework for building apps with large language models (LLMs). Not all automation devs know how to incorporate this into AI workflows. Experience here shows they can build smart, conversational, or generative AI features within workflows. API integration and data transformation expertise Solid understanding of REST, GraphQL APIs, and methods for authentication alongside JSON/XML data manipulation are crucial. Making workflow automation tick often means linking various systems securely and reliably. Workflow architecture and process optimization Dev who gets business processes and can morph them into slick automated workflows add more value. Look for experience in process mining, decision trees, and bottleneck busting. Additional skills Familiarity with cloud platforms (think AWS Lambda, Azure Functions) Version control experience (Git's a plus) A smidge of machine learning and AI concepts iTechNotion gives developers a run-through of these technical skills before matching them to client projects, ensuring quality outcomes. 4. Freelancer vs agency vs in-house — a practical comparison for automation projects Picking the kind of resource you'll hire affects cost, control, and project success. Freelancers Offer flexibility and generally cost less. Perfect for smaller projects or when you need them short-term. Quality control can be a bit of a headache, though. Risk of skill gaps and limited availability is real. Agencies They come with a range of pros, including AI automation devs, project managers, and QA teams. Reliable and packed with expertise, especially handy for complex or continued projects. But expect higher costs. In-house developers Full-timers bring in-depth company knowledge and stick around for the long haul. Great for continuous improvement and strategic automation moves. But recruiting and retention can be a pain. Example: iTechNotion 's clients often start with agency support to test waters, then slowly build their own teams with a little guidance from agency experts. 5. Interview questions that reveal genuine expertise Nailing the right questions will save you time and help find the perfect match. Technical scenarios Explain how you'd mesh a complicated AI model with a business workflow. What challenges pop up when connecting APIs for multiple outside services? How would you go about error management in an asynchronous workflow? Tool-specific questions Break down how you've used n8n or similar tools for advanced automation? Do you have hands-on with LangChain or other AI orchestration frameworks? Process and optimization What's your method for mapping business processes into automation workflows? What metrics do you rely on to track workflow performance and improvements? Behavioral Detail a tough automation project you tackled and the way you ironed out key issues. iTechNotion designs custom technical tasks while screening developers to confirm these skills before client gigs. 6. Red flags to watch for — developers who call themselves automation experts but lack AI depth Watch out for devs who only tinker with simple automation tools yet lack AI chops. Red flags: Heavy reliance on Zapier or similar no-code hookups without tweaks Cannot explain AI basics like NLP, machine learning, or model inference Little experience with API integrations outside standard templates Bland automation claims without examples of AI-driven workflows Zero insights on workflow error management, scaling, or monitoring These folks might churn out partial solutions that neither scale nor fit complex business needs. Check past projects and ask for technical demos during hiring. 7. Project scoping — what to prepare before you hire Before hiring an AI automation developer, have a sharp and detailed project scope ready. It sets expectations and leads to better results. Define business objectives What hurdles should automation clear? Pinpoint specific pain points and goals, like trimming manual input, speeding up tasks, or boosting data accuracy. Map existing workflows Record current processes to uncover automation opportunities, core steps, and integration points. List systems and integrations Offload details about software platforms, available APIs, and data sources in play. Set success criteria Decide how you'll measure outcomes, such as time saved, fewer errors, or happier customers. Budget and timeline Be upfront about constraints so developers can pitch realistic solutions. At iTechNotion , we offer project scoping workshops as the go-to norm to align developers and clients early, mitigate risks, and enhance delivery. 8. How iTechNotion provides dedicated automation developers for client projects iTechNotion ’s forte is linking businesses with screened AI automation developers fine-tuned for project needs. Our approach matches skills, domain know-how, and cultural compatibility. The developers we match are experts in n8n , LangChain, API orchestration, and workflow fine-tuning. We back clients all the way with project management and technical supervision. Take a recent retail client, for example. They sought AI-driven inventory management automation. iTechNotion paired them with a developer who cooked up workflows tying AI demand forecasting and automation, slashing stockouts by 30% in just a few months. We bank on clarity, precise scoping, and continuous communication. Our method combines cutting-edge AI automation with tangible business outcomes and steers clear of overpromising on tech capabilities. If you’re looking to hire an AI automation developer with real skills and experience, iTechNotion ’s on standby to help fast-track your automation journey. Conclusion and Next Steps Nabbing a top-notch AI automation developer calls for recognizing the unique skills and savvy this role demands. Look past simple automation and zero in on developers well-versed in AI workflows, API harmonization, and scalable design. Vet candidates thoroughly with pinpointed interview questions and keep an eye out for red flags like scant AI knowledge. Arm yourself with a solid project scope so your developer can hit home with effective results. iTechNotion offers reliable AI automation developers who help businesses build intelligent workflows and bump up operational efficiency. Reach out today to discuss your project and find seasoned pros prepped to meet your automation goals. Freelancers Offer flexibility and generally cost less. Perfect for smaller projects or when you need them short-term. Quality control can be a bit of a headache, though. Risk of skill gaps and limited availability is real. Agencies They come with a range of pros, including AI automation devs, project managers, and QA teams. Reliable and packed with expertise, especially handy for complex or continued projects. But expect higher costs. In-house developers Full-timers bring in-depth company knowledge and stick around for the long haul. Great for continuous improvement and strategic automation moves. But recruiting and retention can be a pain. Example: iTechNotion 's clients often start with agency support to test waters, then slowly build their own teams with a little guidance from agency experts. 5. Technical scenarios Explain how you'd mesh a complicated AI model with a business workflow. What challenges pop up when connecting APIs for multiple outside services? How would you go about error management in an asynchronous workflow? Tool-specific questions Break down how you've used n8n or similar tools for advanced automation? Do you have hands-on with LangChain or other AI orchestration frameworks? Process and optimization What's your method for mapping business processes into automation workflows? What metrics do you rely on to track workflow performance and improvements? Behavioral Detail a tough automation project you tackled and the way you ironed out key issues. iTechNotion designs custom technical tasks while screening developers to confirm these skills before client gigs. 6. Check past projects and ask for technical demos during hiring. 7. Define business objectives What hurdles should automation clear? Pinpoint specific pain points and goals, like trimming manual input, speeding up tasks, or boosting data accuracy. List systems and integrations Offload details about software platforms, available APIs, and data sources in play. closest.text: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Duties & Responsibilities Support the development of a new calibration data baseline for test chambers and related electrical systems, ensuring a customer-centric focus on accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement. Assist in establishing standardized calibration processes and documentation that are authentic, transparent, and aligned with quality and compliance standards. Contribute to defining and maintaining calibration intervals, demonstrating accountability for data integrity and operational consistency. Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, lab operations, and maintenance teams to support chamber updates, troubleshooting, and repairs in an agile and collaborative manner. Assist in analyzing calibration results and identifying opportunities for process improvements and innovative solutions. Maintain accurate records, reports, and logs to support audits, performance tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives. Support ongoing system monitoring and assist with updates to ensure optimal equipment performance and minimal downtime. Required Skills & Experience Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or a related field. Foundational knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, or calibration concepts. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on innovative and practical solutions. Ability to work collaboratively within cross-functional teams and communicate technical information effectively. High attention to detail and a commitment to accountability and accuracy in technical work. Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word) for documentation and reporting. Willingness to operate in a dynamic, agile environment supporting engineering and lab operations. Professional workplace communication and problem-solving skills. Part-time role, must be available to work 15-20 hours a week during the fall academic term, including on site at Itron’s Liberty Lake location. Role to begin in September. Preferred Skills & Experience Previous internship, lab, or project experience involving calibration, testing, or instrumentation (i.e – network analyzer, oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer) Familiarity with environmental or test chambers, measurement systems, or data acquisition tools. Exposure to utilities, energy, or technology-driven environments with a strong customer-centric focus. Experience interpreting technical drawings, schematics, or calibration standards. Knowledge of quality systems or compliance standards (e.g., ISO-related processes) is a plus. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com . With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Created in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud-based procurement solutions.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionizes supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration. 

We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities. 

Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn 

THE OPPORTUNITY

CONTEXT: 

Our RUN department, international in scope (EMEA, AMER, APAC) and in full growth, is made up of around fifty experts leveraging IVALUA procurement solutions for our customers post go-live. The team is still growing in order to guarantee the satisfaction of a growing number of customers.

ROLE: 

Here at Ivalua, we are currently looking for a Associate Customer Application Engineer. You will be reporting to the RUN Manager of the technical customer support team and you will be responsible for managing the customer relationship on the maintenance of the applications in operational and technical terms. You will own enhancements, Upgrades and Application Performance Tuning Activates. You will be trained and certified on our Buyer application (SaaS Source-to-Pay software package).

WHAT YOU WILL DO WITH US 

  • Manage the customer relationship. Gather business requirements and analyze the impact on the implemented solution. 
  • Advise Customers on procurement leading practices and configuration management.
  • Use Ivalua Buyer technical framework (C# .NET & SQL) to configure and customize Ivalua Buyer solution to meet specific business requirements
  • Reverse engineering and debugging to solve project issues throughout all phases of the implementation cycle
  • Develop advanced configuration knowledge and show strong technical creativity skills to leverage configuration features in order to limit custom code
  • Interact with R&D team for product features
  • Manage deliveries and solve technical operational issues
  • Contribute to peer code review

YOUR PROFILE

If you have the below experience and strengths this role could be for you:

Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in software development, primarily in C#, .NET and SQL Server
  • Ability to understand complex functional and technical environments and communicate technical concepts to non-technical people
  • Comfortable looking for configuration solutions versus new coding and development
  • Functional knowledge of SRM, Supply Chain, and/or Procurement is a plus
  • Experience working on AI - Claude Code 

Soft Skills :

  • BE/BTech or Masters degree in Computer Engineering, Computer science, or a closely related field or foreign equivalent. Procurement domain will be an added advantage.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills  and at ease in a multicultural environment
  • Manage client relationships, self-driven, results oriented, strong leadership and exceptional communication skills.

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

If your application fits this specific position’s needs, our skilled Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial screening call. Get one step closer to achieving your goals – apply today! 

Our Talent team will guide you through every step of the interview process - from preparation to completion. They're here to support you! 

Our recruitment process is designed to assess your competencies through a series of personalized interviews with internal stakeholders relevant to the role. 

Interviews will be conducted virtually via video or on-site with face-to-face meetings.

LIFE AT IVALUA

  • Hybrid working model (3 days in the office per week)
  • We're a team dedicated to pushing the boundaries of product innovation and technology, Sustainable Growth, Privately Held
  • A stable and cash-flow positive Company since 10 years
  • Snacks and weekly lunches in the office
  • Feel empowered to pursue your goals with improved team collaboration and increased creativity/productivity
  • Unlock and unleash your full professional potential with our exceptional training and career development program
  • Join a dynamic and international team of top-notch professionals who are experts in their respective fields. Collaborate with like-minded individuals who are deeply passionate and highly motivated about their work. Experience a truly diverse and inclusive work environment where your unique contributions are highly valued
  • Regular social events, competitive outings, team running events, and musical activities
  • Comparably recognized Ivalua for the following (https://www.comparably.com/companies/ivalua) :

To help our customers make supply chains more efficient, sustainable and resilient, we rely on a global team with a variety of backgrounds, skills and views. We believe in equal opportunity and in diversity as a driver of innovation that cultivates a spirit of inclusiveness, creates a productive and fun place to work, and provides fulfilling career opportunities for all Ivaluans - Ivalua Linkedin

nearMatches.text:
Are you driven to be an innovative Site Reliability Engineer, and looking to join a team where open collaboration, customer focus, and a commitment to excellence are core values? At Ivanti, we work passionately and authentically, striving to win together and make a real impact for our customers and each other. Join us to elevate your career and help deliver innovative solutions in a dynamic, empowering environment.

Why this role matters:

The Site Reliability Engineering role is a blend of infrastructure, networking, operating systems, automation, development, and application administration. It is a hands-on technical position in a fast-paced atmosphere. The ideal candidate has prior experience managing cloud-based SaaS applications and strives to solve traditional operations problems through automation and software. More so, the candidate must possess a high standard of excellence, have a strong customer focus, and is capable of technical deep dives into code, app servers, databases, load balancers, operating systems, and networks.

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) is a growing team that partners closely with Product Engineering, Security, and Support. We are responsible for the reliability, deployment, and continuous operation of the Ivanti Cloud services.  We need your help to take our existing platform to the next level with observability, release automation, chaos engineering, and more.

What you'll do:

  • Work 4 x 10-hour days (Tuesday (night) to Saturday (morning), approximately 10 PM to 9 AM U.S. Pacific Time, including lunch)
  • Deploy, manage, and secure Ivanti’s production Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environments in AWS and Azure
  • Work with a geographically dispersed, cross-departmental teams to solve difficult problems
  • Automate common and repetitive tasks
